description.value: Lucky Donair is a Mediterranean fast-food spot in Langley Township serving shawarma, donairs, and wraps made with lamb, chicken, or plant-based fillings, all wrapped in fresh pita. Customer reviews highlight the clean interior, generous portions, and quick, friendly service. The menu also extends into Mediterranean sides like falafel, spanakopita, and baklawa, making it a solid stop for a substantial mid-ride meal.
